title: Project-scoped persistence endpoints
description: Scope /api/layout, /api/history, and /api/history/cursor to a project, resolving projects/<slug>/planting_layout.csv and layout-history.json. Validate the slug shape and confirm resolved paths stay inside the projects directory, since a client-supplied id now feeds a file path.
acceptance_criteria: Endpoints read/write the correct project files; traversal attempts and malformed slugs are rejected with 400; omitting the project falls back to the default.

title: Make viewBox, offsets, and backgrounds per-project
description: Thread per-project viewBox dimensions and elevation offsets through configureViews, topView, elevationViews, and the bundle export instead of reading module-level constants. Move the hard-coded background URLs out of styles.css and app.js VIEW_BACKGROUNDS so they come from project config.
acceptance_criteria: No renderer reads PLAN_VIEWBOX/ELEVATION_VIEWBOX directly for geometry; constants remain only as defaults; backgrounds are applied from project config.

title: Compass-direction elevation views
description: Generalize renderSouthElevation/renderEastElevation into one renderer driven by the compass direction the viewer stands on (north/south/east/west), deriving the horizontal yard axis, whether it is mirrored, and the front-to-back depth ordering. View labels come from project config instead of hard-coded index.html text, and the elevation drag controllers use the project-derived axis.
acceptance_criteria: Viewing from south/east reproduces today's output exactly; viewing from north/west mirrors the horizontal axis and reverses depth ordering; labels reflect config.

title: Project config schema, loader, and on-disk migration
description: Add projects/index.json + projects/<slug>/project.json, a src/data/projectConfig.js loader that normalizes and validates config, and migrate the existing yard into projects/backyard/ (planting_layout.csv + img/).
acceptance_criteria: projectConfig parses and normalizes a config with defaults; invalid slugs and missing fields are rejected; existing backyard renders unchanged from its new location.

title: Support multiple projects
description: Allow the app to host several landscape projects, each with its own background images, canvas dimensions, and compass orientation for the elevation views. plants.csv stays a shared global species catalog; each project has its own planting_layout.csv so its species selection is implicitly separate. Projects are authored on disk (projects/<slug>/) and chosen in-app via a picker that navigates to ?project=<slug>.
design: On-disk convention: projects/index.json lists projects; projects/<slug>/project.json declares viewBoxes, background images, default scale, and the compass direction each elevation is viewed from; projects/<slug>/planting_layout.csv holds placements; projects/<slug>/img/ holds backgrounds. Switching projects reloads the page with ?project=<slug> rather than re-initializing app state in place. Yard axes: origin SW, x increases east, y increases north.

title: Add Playwright end-to-end browser tests
description: No automated browser tests exist; tests/ is all node --test unit tests with a fake DOM. Add Playwright e2e specs that boot server.js and assert on rendered SVG DOM (not screenshots) so agents need not drive Chrome manually.

title: Remove four-nerve daisies from backyard layout
description: Two four-nerve-daisy-front rows in projects/backyard/planting_layout.csv should be deleted.

title: Tests and docs for multi-project support
description: Cover project config parsing, compass-direction elevation geometry, and server project path resolution. Update tests/persistence.test.cjs for the project-scoped URL, and update AGENTS.md (mirrored into CLAUDE.md) for the new on-disk layout.
acceptance_criteria: npm test passes; AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md describe projects/ and how to add a project.

title: Project picker UI and ?project= routing
description: Add a project selector to the header that navigates to ?project=<slug>; app.js resolves the active project from the query string, falling back to the default in projects/index.json.
acceptance_criteria: Selecting a project reloads into that project; an unknown or missing slug falls back to the default with a visible notice.

title: Layout history seeds bypass parsePlantLayoutCsv validation
description: appState.plants can come from layoutHistoryInstance.getCurrentPlants() (src/app.js), which is seeded from the server's layout-history.json. Those entries are plain plant arrays and never pass through parsePlantLayoutCsv, so the duplicate-id constraint added in nl-92d does not cover them. Not reachable today: cloning routes through buildCloneId, CSV load now throws, and a scan of projects/example-frontyard/layout-history.json (6 entries) found no duplicates. Worth closing if a future path writes history directly.
acceptance_criteria: Either history seeds are validated on load, or a note records why the path is safe by construction.

title: Duplicate plant id in backyard planting_layout.csv
description: projects/backyard/planting_layout.csv has two rows sharing the id 'four-nerve-daisy-front' (lines 26 and 27). Ids are used to look up plants for dragging, cloning, and hover/target highlighting, so the second row is effectively unreachable — dragging either silhouette moves the first match. Pre-existing, found while verifying the multi-project change; not caused by it.
acceptance_criteria: Every id in planting_layout.csv is unique; consider validating uniqueness in parsePlantLayoutCsv.
close_reason: Duplicates already removed by nl-y8y; parsePlantLayoutCsv now throws on repeated ids, with unit tests.
